## Walkcast 0.10.6

### Brag-style product films in Launch Studio

- Generate a concise 20-second launch film with an opening hook, moving excerpts from the real capture, and a closing title.
- Choose polished, cinematic, or playful motion and landscape, vertical, or square output.
- Create an original score with tone-matched transitions, local Kokoro narration, and embedded English captions.
- Download the storyboard and generated share copy alongside the MP4 and poster.
- Keep rendering on the desktop with the existing local browser, FFmpeg, and Kokoro pipeline.
- Fix Launch Studio task polling so completed renders no longer remain visually stuck at an old percentage.
